i.norm: Verifies that when the RcData static option flag is reassigned and a tag's options field is set to match that value, textState() reads the updated flag correctly, and the tag's namespace is preserved as originally set.
"Oc2" is not a standard HTML tag name, so the resulting tag should be unknown
Reassign the RcData static flag to 512 and mirror that value in the tag's options field, so that is(RcData) returns true and textState() returns TokeniserState.Rcdata
The namespace supplied at creation ("Oc2") must be returned unchanged
